title: A customer survey
bodyMd: A software company surveys paying users through an in-app pop-up. Responses are overwhelmingly positive. The research lead notes that customers who stopped using the product rarely see the invitation. She recommends contacting former subscribers separately. The existing survey may accurately describe respondents, she says, while still giving an incomplete account of all customer experiences.
